verdict.rationale: Vendor docs describe an agent that resolves issues end-to-end and coordinates specialist agents through multi-step, multi-system workflows, taking actions via APIs inside natural-language and deterministic workflows. This implies troubleshooting beyond a single canned reply, but nothing explicitly says the agent asks clarifying questions or runs iterative diagnosis with the customer. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of clarifying-question behavior, documented multi-turn troubleshooting examples, independent or hands-on corroboration.
